title: Rav Dimi bar Chinena (I)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman calls him Rav Chisda’s colleague. In [Zevachim 36b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.36b.10), Rav Chisda says that Rav Dimi bar Chinena used to teach that one is liable on grounds of impurity for unroasted meat of the Passover offering. In [Rosh Hashanah 34b](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.34b.15), Rabbi Chiyya son of Rabbah bar Nachmani, whom Hyman calls a student of Rav Chisda, went and presented the teaching before Rav Dimi bar Chinena. The supplied notice breaks off: “And there is [1] …”[^1]

notes.text: Zevachim also mentions the thanksgiving offering’s loaves. In the print, the notice begins on [p. 331](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3f/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._I._1910.pdf#page=362) and ends at ויש (“and there is”) on [p. 332](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3f/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._I._1910.pdf#page=363), just before the heading Rav Dimi bar Chinena (II).
